title: Burt G NDE 5289
content: I was suffering from Rocky Mountain spotted tick fever. I was having experiences that are very hard to describe. Hallucinations had become everyday experiences for me. I remember some of them, but thank God have forgotten most. I remember almost nothing about 04/08/2010 except my NDE. I told my wife about it, but she was skeptical until I told her which bathroom I was in and the position of my body. I was having this delusion that I was half man and half dog, with super human strength (this is one of the memories I retain) when I found myself floating out of my body. The best way for me to describe the feelings I had when this happened has taken me almost a year to figure out, and I got it from watching my beloved dog Samson. I was making a funny noise at him, just to watch him cock his head. Dog lovers have all watched and laughed at our dogs for doing this. What I realized was that my dog's feeling of bewilderment was the same bewilderment I felt, looking down at my own body! After a second or so, a sense of peace overcame all my emotions, and I knew I was looking at my now lifeless body. I did not care! It was a relief to know it was over. I knew I was very near Heaven - but almost instantly, I knew I could not stay there. It seems like it happened both in a second and in fifteen minutes all at once. In the place where I found myself, time had no meaning whatsoever. That feeling of being complete remains with me, and sometimes for a brief instant, I get a glimpse of what I felt - and I wish everyone could have this feeling!! Then all of a sudden - wham - I was right back in that painful crumpled body on the floor. It felt like I was pushed, and I did not want to go back.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt like he was pushed back into his body ('wham - I was right back... It felt like I was pushed').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported being 'very near Heaven' but said he could not stay.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred without tunnel/light/encounters; rapid return ('wham') followed.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He said it seemed like it happened 'both in a second and in fifteen minutes all at once.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prior to the OBE he described illness-related hallucinations/delusions, including believing he was 'half man and half dog, with super human strength.' He compared his initial reaction on seeing his body to a dog's 'bewilderment.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “After a second or so, a sense of peace overcame all my emotions, and I knew I was looking at my now lifeless body. I did not care! It was a relief to know it was over.” “It seems like it happened both in a second and in fifteen minutes all at once. In the place where I found myself, time had no meaning whatsoever.” “Then all of a sudden - wham - I was right back in that painful crumpled body on the floor. It felt like I was pushed, and I did not want to go back.”
